description: This Java source file defines the `DraggableDot` custom view class used for drag-and-drop interactions within an Android application. It handles rendering a circle with optional label, manages drag events including shadow drawing and simulated ANR scenarios, and processes drop data to update a report view.

classes.name: DraggableDot
classes.description: A custom View subclass implementing draggable circle with drag-and-drop support and visual effects.

classes.name: ANRShadowBuilder
classes.description: Inner class extending DragShadowBuilder, capable of inducing an Application Not Responding (ANR) scenario by sleeping during shadow drawing.

methods.name: sleepSixSeconds
methods.description: Induces a deliberate 6-second pause to simulate an ANR condition.

methods.name: ANRShadowBuilder
methods.description: Constructor for the shadow builder, optionally inducing ANR.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles custom drawing of the circle and label, with glow effect when dragging.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures view size based on radius and padding.

methods.name: onDragEvent
methods.description: Handles drag events such as start, enter, exit, drop, and end; manages visual feedback and drop processing.

methods.name: processDrop
methods.description: Processes dropped data and updates the report view with text info.
